home_eyebrow: Bunkhouse Sleeps Family of 10 or 6 Adults
card3_text: A 72" x 80" king, a full bed over the cab, bunks, two pull-out couches and a dinette conversion bed. Ten berths suits kids in the mix; six adults is the comfortable number. Eight seatbelts for travel.
card2_text: A 12 cu ft 4-door RV refer with a real freezer, plus cooktop, oven, residential microwave and a complete set of cookware, dishware and utensils on board.
card1_text: The Dining Table faces the Couch rather than a wall — rare in a Class A, and the reason Dinner, Games and Hangout actually work in here. Swivel the cab seats around, add a few lawn chairs, and you can seat 12.
home_intro:
Ever wonder why most RVs have all the seating on the same wall so you're not facing each other? 

In our family's 2020 Forest River FR3 the couch faces the dining table so everyone can see each other.  It's the best floor plan for dinner, games, and hanging out.

cards_intro: A king bed, a full bed over the cab, two pull-out couches, a dinette conversion and bunks. Ten berths in total, which works out to roughly six adults in comfort. Complete specifications are on the next page.

own_para1: This is a single privately owned RV rather than one unit out of a rental fleet. It is inspected mechanically, deep-cleaned and restocked by the owner between every rental, and every renter receives the same vehicle in the same condition.
own_para2: The practical result is direct answers before you book, a 45-minute systems walkthrough before you depart, and a direct line to the owner for the duration of your rental.
own_point1: One owner, one RV — the one you see is the one you receive
own_point2: Mechanical inspection and deep clean between every rental
